title: statusline r4 SA: multi-repo conduct criterion has no fixture and leans on the 1c wiring script
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 4. Lens: solution-architect (validator: solution-owner). Owner: SO session. Defect: the composed multi-repo conduct clause has no corpus member, and its composing mechanism is the wiring script whose shape is routed to 1c — a current criterion transitively requiring a future milestone's implementation; not covered by the aggregate-cost routing, which deferred cost, not conduct verification. Citations verified: contract:185 vs :170, :160. Proposed: resolved-candidate via SA's own second option: seed a two-repo composition fixture (built from two single-repo fixtures) into the corpus; sequencing is safe since 1c designs the script shape before the acceptance suite is built.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree per SA's own second option: a two-repo composition fixture assembled from two single-repo members added to the corpus for the composed-display conduct checks — corpus-completeness restored; sequencing safe since 1c designs the wiring-script shape before the acceptance suite is built.
